description: Frederik Zahle and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The actual FUSED-Wind software framework connects wind-energy analysis and design tools. Its native release and public FUSED-Wind/fusedwind repository establish Python implementation and Apache-2.0 terms; current repository metadata marks it archived. Source-linked toolset material describes HawtOpt, AirfoilOpt and historical TOPFARM applications. Those names are retained as hosted-tool evidence without asserting identity with newer packages of similar names. The resource supports multidisciplinary wind-system modelling while current maintenance and compatibility with later dependencies are not established. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label apache2.0. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
